body.p: In the beginning all people lived with Mungu, the Babali as well as the Basua. One day Mungu sent them all out to hunt swine. The Babali started out first, and came back in the evening empty-handed. The Bambuti then tried their luck, and killed a pig, which they ate on the spot. When Mungu heard this he was so annoyed that he banished them into the forest, where they live to this day. The leader of the Bambuti whom Mungu banished into the forest was called "Mbera," the ancestor of all the pigmies. Although Mungu was very angry with the pigmies, he was not cruel to them, and gave them fruit trees from which they could eat to their heart's content. These trees were the akbu, the akasi, the tobe, the giezi and many others."
